best_match.fbbt_term: immature proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm4
best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm4 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Hth/Opa temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: 'Pm4' is FBbt:00111282 'proximal medullary amacrine neuron Pm4'; at P15-P40 the cells are developing, so its immature form FBbt:00052323 (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Proximal medullary amacrine neuron that branches at the proximal surface of the medulla. It covers around 10-20 columns with its pre- and post-synapses mostly in layers M8-M9 (Nern et al., 2025). It occupies a central intracolumnar position. It is GABAergic (Davis et al., 2020). There are around 75-85 of these neurons per hemisphere (Nern et al., 2025).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form; used from the pharate adult stage.
